conditions: Coordinates positiveaft; small-trim hydrostatics.

conditions: Nonzero shiftarm, target increment not totaltrim.

conditions: Reference geometry, lineartrim; avoid unsigned plus/minusrecipes.

conditions: Draftsmetres, TPCt/cm; explicit100. Higher trim corrections separate.

name: Quarter-mean draft approximation
conditions: Empirical hog/sag approximation, not exact hull-volume integration or substitute for approved survey procedure.

name: Reference volume conversion
conditions: VCF must match the appropriate authorized liquid class,T,density reference; no ASTM table values copied.

name: Maximum-temperature allowed volume
conditions: Margin fraction0…1, not percent number. Tank certification and legal fill limits are separate.

name: Reference volume at maximum fill
conditions: VCF at maximum expected temperature.

name: Loading-temperature allowed volume
conditions: Conserved mass/reference volume, positive VCF.

name: Gross standard volume
conditions: GOV excludes free water under the declared measurement procedure; do not subtract OBQ twice.

name: Net transferred observed volume
conditions: Inventory difference with the same volume/statebasis; OBQ is the inventory before loading, not a universal GOV subtraction.

name: True cargo mass from standard volume

name: Ullage volume
conditions: Volume ullage differs from vertical ullage height; tank calibration needed.

name: Ullage percent
conditions: Percent number, positive capacity.

name: Fill fraction
conditions: Percent divided by 100; source wording mixes decimal fraction and %.

name: Simplified grain free-shift virtual GM term
conditions: Historical approximation with specified grain geometry; not current International Grain Code compliance or a substitute for approved grain heeling moments.

conditions: Specified rectangular shift geometry, prescribed angle; actual grain heeling moments require approved data.

name: Small-angle grain equilibrium
conditions: Positive GM, small-angle initial stability only.

conditions: Reduced buoyancy from a local immersion change; R_t in tonne-equivalent force, actual N=1000gRt. Small changes and appropriately corrected draft.

name: Longitudinal reaction arm
conditions: Small trim, reaction relative to LCF; nonzero reaction.

conditions: Keel support at zero datum, 0<Rt<Δ, idealized remaining-buoyancy reference. Ground restraint and actual stability are more complex.

name: Transverse reaction arm estimate
conditions: Simplified static heel model with appropriately corrected GM, not general grounding assessment.

name: Docking critical-reaction approximation
conditions: Source assumes LCF near midships, first keel contact near an end; actual location/hydrostatics change result.

name: Even-keel geometric draft target
conditions: Arithmetic mean held fixed; not a guaranteed refloating condition.

name: Required trim-shifting mass
conditions: Internal shift arm a is nonzero; hydrostatic iterationneeded.

conditions: Downward net load and chosen cut sign; free endV0=0.
